card.name: The letter C starting CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: The capital C that begins CYP enzyme names (CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP1A2) in drug interaction text. It usually follows words like Strong, Use with, or a bullet.

modes.label: CYP after Strong or Use with
modes.description: C opens CYP right after a phrase such as Strong or Use with, before Inhibitors or Inducers.

modes.label: CYP at list or heading start
modes.description: C opens CYP at the start of a bullet or heading naming substrates or enzymes.

modes.label: Other C drug names
modes.description: C opens another interacting drug name such as cimetidine after a section number.
